AUDITOR_ATTESTATION.label: Auditor attestation
AUDITOR_ATTESTATION.text: An admitted auditor signed this statement about one lease. It is an attestation. It is not proof of storage.

PROVIDER_RECEIPT.label: Provider receipt
PROVIDER_RECEIPT.text: A transfer receipt attributed to a provider. This beta does not check its signature and does not record it on chain. It is an attestation. It is not proof of storage or of future delivery.

RECORDED.label: Recorded
RECORDED.text: The auditor reported the lease's manifest digest. The chain compared two digests and fetched nothing. The manifest digest is public. Reporting it does not show that any byte was fetched. A recorded attestation describes one past observation. It does not show that the lease is held or the content is available now.

REJECTED.label: Rejected
REJECTED.text: The auditor reported a digest that differs from the lease's manifest digest. This can mean a failed or mismatched check. The chain did not check why. A rejected record does not expire. The chain cannot tell whether the provider or the auditor caused the difference.

EXPIRED.label: Expired
EXPIRED.text: The attestation's expiry time has passed.

event_accepted: EvidenceAccepted means the record was written to the ledger. It does not mean the check passed.

acceptance.label: Provider acceptance
acceptance.text: The provider signed the package digest, byte count and terms. Acceptance is a promise, not possession.

limitations: Providers may fetch from another host.
Node IDs do not prove independent replicas.
A valid signature does not make an observation true.
Accounting success is not physical capacity or operator independence.
A sampled check covers only the sampled segments.
This auditor is not shown to be independent of the provider.
No evidence record renews, extends or revives a lease, in any state.
No cryptographic storage proof exists in this beta. It is a separate decision gate.
